title: One of our players found an infinite jump bug while testing, kind of want to keep it as a easter egg feature
author: Kajamaz
selftext: They were doing an invisible maze quest and found you can wall jump infinitely on invisible walls. Should I keep it in as a easter egg?

comments.author: Fit_Eye_3564
comments.body: Maybe an npc does it some cutscene animation or in the background? But I wouldn't keep it with actual gameplay

comments.author: DancinFool82
comments.body: Don't keep a bug like this

comments.author: Big_Presentation2786
comments.body: You're happy with your broken game?!

comments.author: SilliCarl
comments.body:
probably not. I think this risks coming across as being lazy to fix it rather than finding it funny and keeping it as an easter egg. At least thats how I'd feel if i found it in a game.

Plus the more polished your game, the less people can levy the dreaded "slop" at you xD

comments.author: PerformanceComes1st
comments.body: is this the first time you ever make a game? its like the most basic thing ever, not worthy of an easter egg, they explain how to avoid it to you in the most simple 5 minute unity/godot/gamemaker tutorials ever

comments.author: alanbdee
comments.body: It happened with Satisfactory and the hypertube cannon. It's up to you to decide if it ruins the game. Exploits like that can because if the game becomes too easy, its no longer fun. I think of 100% invisibility in Oblivion as an example. Once you have that, you can just walk around stabbing people. Takes all the fun out of the game and I usually stop playing at that point.

comments.author: gay_married
comments.body:
People are down on you but there is an audience for this type of thing: speedrunners. I follow some speedrunners and it's funny hearing them say things like "I'll speedrun OoT remake if any good glitches are found" - a perfectly tested game with no bugs is actually a downside for this odd audience.

But if your game isn't 20 hours long then it doesn't really matter anyway.

comments.author: drahgon
comments.body: Yea don’t keep bugs in your game. Easter eggs are deliberate not accidents. They are designed in this could have other bad effects you do not know about since you didn’t design it

comments.author: strange_username58
comments.body: Make it a cheat code, I miss cheat codes
